verified: Electrek reports that Tesla unveiled Powercore, describing it as one unit combining a solid-state medium-voltage transformer, inverter, and breaker; Tesla’s stated ratings are 7.4 MW (9 MVA) continuous at 34.5 kV and grid-forming support up to 10 MVA peak, with US manufacturing and a 2027 operating target.
unconfirmed: Tesla has not shown shipped units, customer deployments, pricing, or independent test results; the 7.4 MW/9 MVA and 10 MVA figures are Tesla’s own claims, the exact 2027 start date is a schedule rather than a demonstrated milestone, and Heron Power’s 2027 volume-production target for Heron Link is likewise a company plan.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，特斯拉发布了 Powercore，称其是集变压器、逆变器和断路器功能于一体的固态中压设备，连续额定 7.4 MW（9 MVA）、电压 34.5 kV，并具备最高 10 MVA 峰值的构网能力，计划 2027 年开始运行。
unconfirmed: 上述性能指标均来自特斯拉方面，尚无独立测试或已投运机组佐证；价格、客户部署和确切投运日期也未公布。Heron Power 计划 2027 年量产 Heron Link 同样只是公司规划；TechCrunch 2026 年 2 月报道其融资 1.4 亿美元以扩大固态变压器产能，但量产时间和规模尚未兑现。

titles.en: Tesla unveils 7.4 MW Powercore solid-state transformer for 2027
titles.zh: 特斯拉发布 7.4 MW Powercore 固态变压器，2027 年投运
